A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (the game-text box of the 0 side) with the corrected game text, and below it a black strip with the title and a white E, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its Decipher Errata sheet dated 1 January 2013.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Endor-L-rebelstriketeam-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed]] (Decipher, June 1999): The game text changes to Decipher's errata wording, the same words as [[Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed (Decipher Errata 2002)|Decipher's 2002 errata]]: “Deploy Endor system and Rebel Landing Site. '''While''' this side up, opponent loses no more than 1 Force from each of your Force drains at Endor locations. Once during each of your deploy phases, may use 2 Force to take one Bunker or Deactivate The Shield Generator into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. '''Flip''' this card if Bunker “blown away” or if, during your move phase, you control three exterior Endor sites (with two Rebel scouts at each). '''Place''' out of play if Endor “blown away.””. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with the title “•Rebel Strike Team” and a white italic “E”.

The lower part of the earlier card image (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
